title: qec-distance-certificates: certificate-based distance verification for CSS Reed-Muller quantum codes
description: Certificate-based distance verification for CSS(RM(r,m), RM(r,m)) affine-complete quantum error-correcting codes. Produces a machine-checkable certificate locking the distance d = 2^(r+1) in polynomial time, with a brute-force enumeration baseline as an independent reference path.
